name: Dawson McCoun
why: WKU's own directory portrait, single subject, full face, uncropped and unresized. WKU publishes it on his own HonorsToppers profile page, which is headed with his name and carries the img title 'Dawson McCoun'. The page makes him a Political Science and Public Relations major from Frankfort, Kentucky, class of 2022, which puts him a sophomore in 2019-20 and a junior in 2020-21, the two years the archive records him as a senator and then chair of Legislative Research. McCoun is a rare surname and the only other bearers the archive knows are Addison McCoun, a separate person already recorded, and Jack McCoun in 2023-24.

name: Lane Hedrick
why: The archive already holds this portrait, but only against the other spelling of her name: SGA's own judicial page calls her Katherine (Lane) Hedrick, which is the 2016-17 entry, while the 2018-19 Acting Chief Justice is entered as Lane Hedrick, so the face never reached that year. data/name-aliases.json already asserts the two are one person. Same file, no second copy cut. Identification is the Herald naming the same student twice in the same academic year: its SGA meeting report of 22 March 2017 says 'Lane Hedrick was selected to be the next associate chief justice', and this single-subject studio portrait of a WKU junior named Lane Hedrick ran on 3 November 2017. The paper's own duplicate upload of the frame is titled WEB_BosniaPortrait_Lane_LSchweickart2.jpg, so the Herald itself calls it a portrait of Lane. One person in the frame, plain grey backdrop, full face.
caption_quote: Junior Lane Hedrick, studied and interned in Bosnia over the summer.

src.label: College Heights Herald, 3 November 2017, 'From Bosnia to Bowling Green: students share world experiences'; SGA role confirmed by the Herald's SGA report of 22 March 2017, 'SGA supports military students through legislation'

name: Lillian Nellans
why: The same spelling problem as Hedrick: the archive already holds this portrait against Lily Nellans in 2016-17, while the 2017-18 Legislative Research chair is entered as Lillian Nellans, so the face never reached that year. Same file, no second copy cut. The two spellings are the Herald's own, for one person in one organisation across consecutive semesters: its SGA report of 25 October 2017 quotes 'Legislative Research Committee Chair Lillian Nellans' arguing for Resolution 2-17-F, which is exactly the office and year on the worklist, and this portrait ran the previous April captioned Lily Nellans and describing her SGA presidential run. Lily is the ordinary short form of Lillian, and no second Nellans appears anywhere in SGA's records or the Herald's photo library. Single subject, full face, but only 420x525 and slightly soft.

name: Joe Hunter
why: The only photograph of him the Herald holds, and he is the only person in the frame, so the caption cannot be read onto anyone else. A dignified working photograph: he is planting flags on Centennial Mall for veterans he knew. Face is three-quarter and looking down but sharp and well lit. Cropped from 1501x950 to head and shoulders; not upscaled. Identification does not rest on name plus timing: the Herald's veterans feature of 2 December 2014 names 'Madisonville junior Joe Hunter, SVA Vice President' and reports that SGA approved Hunter's proposal to expand the SVA office on 18 November 2014, which is inside his 2014-15 senate year and ties the same man to both organisations. The March 2016 caption then calls him president of SVA and a current WKU student, the same officer one step up.
caption_quote: Joe Hunter, the president of SVA, a current student at WKU and a former Marine

src.label: College Heights Herald, 17 March 2016, photograph by Srijita Chattopadhyay of Joe Hunter planting flags on Centennial Mall; SGA and SVA link from the Herald of 2 December 2014, 'Veterans adjust to college, civilian life'

name: Fransisco Serrano
why: The best face the Herald holds of him and it is inside his SGA year: 28 February 2017, suited, standing with a microphone, sharp and evenly lit, everyone else in the frame out of focus in the foreground. The caption names two people but assigns them by what they are doing - Serrano is the one translating, and the standing speaker with the microphone is the translator, while Laura Torras is the woman whose question he is translating. The same man appears alone in two later single-subject frames captioned only 'Francisco Serrano' (the DACA rally of 25 August 2017 and the march of 7 September 2017), so the face is confirmed against captions that name nobody else. The SGA tie is the Herald's own: its report of 15 September 2016 lists the fall election winners and prints 'Francisco Serrano' among the Student Senators at Large, which is exactly the office and year the archive records, with the Herald spelling Francisco and the archive Fransisco. Cropped from 1501x1001; not upscaled.
caption_quote: Francisco Serrano translates Laura Torras question from Spanish to English for the panel

src.label: College Heights Herald, 1 March 2017, immigration forum in Downing Student Union, 28 February 2017; SGA seat from the Herald of 15 September 2016, 'Fall SGA senators selected after election'
